Iliad Illuminated is a project of Wendell Piez, from 2026

With grateful acknowledgement of forerunners and sources including (among many) the Perseus Digital Library and Text Encoding Initiative (TEI), this derivative work is made available under the terms of CC BY-SA (Creative Commons license: free to use with acknowledgement; share alike).

Design goals include complementarity with other open source resources, while pages are standalone and independent, suitable for cache, copy, and off-network use. If you like what you see, make a copy.

Code in this project is made by hand, or under automation using deterministic methods (data transformations). The foundation is the XML stack (XProc, XSLT, XPath), with the assistance of the Laminator library. No LLMs, probabilistic code generators or AI coding assistants have been used, except for occasional and incidental background research. No connections are made and no one reads or records you, your inputs or interactions.

Project source code is available to inspect and acquire from Github in the developer's EpicMarkup repository.

For more study materials on Homer and Ancient Greek by the developer, see the RavenTracks project; see Pellucid Literature for more declarative markup for — and as — literary study.
